title: Anthropic commits $100 million to train 10,000 engineers to put AI to work
summary: Anthropic announced Claude Frontier Academy, a $100 million program to train 10,000 engineers by the end of 2027 to put AI to work inside large companies. Training starts with a few days in person in San Francisco, New York, or London, followed by a 12-week residency at the engineer's own company. Early partners include Accenture, Deloitte, McKinsey, and Morgan Stanley.
why_it_matters: Anthropic says a shortage of people who know how to put AI to work is holding businesses back, and this program is its attempt to close that gap.
